theorems.name: Submission.rsd_cmr_imrep_restrict
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U U' A : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (θ : Euclid P → ℕ), MeasurableSet A → R.carrier ∩ A ⊆ U' → Measurable θ → (∀ x ∈ R.carrier ∩ A, 0 < θ x) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U' → ∫⁻ x in R.carrier ∩ A ∩ K, (θ x : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μHE[n] ≠ ∞) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R.carrier ∩ A)), ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ μHE[n] ((R.carrier \ A) ∩ ball x δ) = 0) → ∃ R' : IMRep U' n, R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ A ∧ R'.mult = θ ∧ R'.orient = R.orient
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
